UPSTREAM: vboot: standardize on working data size Previously, the size of memory made for vboot_working_data through the macro VBOOT2_WORK was always specified in each individual memlayout file. However, there is effectively no reason to provide this customizability -- the workbuf size required for verifying firmware has never been more than 12K. (This could potentially increase in the future if key sizes or algorithms are changed, but this could be applied globally rather than for each individual platform.)
